item.title: 🔒 The Rent gains another A-List concert with Post Malone in June
item.description: It had been 18 years between A-list concerts at Rentschler Field in East Hartford when Chris Brown performed there last summer. Music fans in Connecticut didn’t have to wait that long for the next big concert.

item.title: 🔒 Last-mile delivery firm UniUni leases 43,000 sq. ft. at Meriden industrial complex
item.description: Fast-growing last-mile delivery carrier leases 43,000-sq-ft space in Meriden

item.title: 🔒 Proposal would convert vacant Wethersfield industrial building into supermarket
item.description: KCH Trading Inc. is seeking approval to reuse the roughly 104,700-square-foot building at 1000 Silas Deane Highway as a bulk-oriented grocery operation.

item.title: CT politics: Scanlon’s campaign, Bronin endorsement
item.description: Connecticut's top elected officials are launching their reelection campaigns as educators sound the alarm about federal funding cuts and policy changes affecting schools. Meanwhile, a former Hartford mayor picked up a national progressive endorsement in the race for Congress.

item.title: Reliability in Action: A Year in Review
item.description: At Eversource, delivering safe and reliable electric service to our customers is a year-round priority. As we reaffirm that commitment in 2026, our team is working harder than ever to ensure the electric system is smarter and more resilient with fewer outages, all while allowing for seamless connection to new clean energy sources that will help meet current and future energy demands of residents and businesses.

item.title: 🔒 Anthony Amenta to retire after 40 years shaping CT architecture firm
item.description: Hartford-based Amenta Emma Architects co-founder Anthony 'Tony' Amenta will retire Feb. 13 after four decades leading the firm he established with Robert Emma in 1985.

item.title: 🔒 Lyons Auto Service in West Hartford sold to regional chain
item.description: Lyons Auto Service, a family-owned business in West Hartford for more than 40 years, was recently acquired by Maine-based VIP Tires & Service.

item.title: Kitchen appliance retailer buys two-building property next to Norwalk showroom for $5M
item.description: The owner of a Massachusetts-based retailer of high-end kitchen appliances has purchased a two-building commercial property next to the company’s Norwalk showroom for $5 million, according to city land records. […]

item.title: FTC warns major law firms with Connecticut offices over DEI hiring practices
item.description: Seven Connecticut law firms received FTC warning letters questioning whether their diversity program participation violates antitrust laws, reflecting the Trump administration's scrutiny of corporate DEI initiatives.
